Class LODManager

java.lang.Object
org.swarmforge.client.view.LODManager
public class LODManager extends Object
Level-of-Detail Manager for optimizing 3D rendering performance. Selects appropriate mesh complexity based on distance from camera.

LOD Levels:

  • HIGH - Full detailed mesh with all body parts and legs
  • MEDIUM - Simplified mesh with basic body shapes
  • LOW - Billboard sprite or single box
  • CULLED - Not rendered (too far)
